issues.description: Attribute 'self.number_of_bits_classical_register' in class GroverLightsOutPuzzle is typed inconsistently: the template initializes it as the string "0" which will be passed to ClassicalRegister (template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) while the solution initializes it as the integer 4 (solution_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py). The problem statement exercise asks students to choose a number of classical bits (an integer). Using a string in the template will cause a runtime TypeError when constructing the ClassicalRegister and prevents students from running or testing the circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template (template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) change the declaration to use an integer number of classical bits. For example: self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 4. Ensure the value is an int so it can be passed to ClassicalRegister() (matching the solution implementation).
